# GFunnel Methodology (Omni Process)

> A unified framework claiming one invariant algorithm — DETECT → PROCESS → RESPOND — operating at every scale of reality. Expressed in 17 layers, 10 Universal Process Domains, and 70+ operational algorithms (v5.1), run against itself at higher resolution (v5.2), and extended with a meta-tier, the Container ⊙ (v5.3), then run through it (v5.4). Authored by Cameron Garlick, GFunnel, Austin, Texas.

Read AGENTS.md first for the operating protocol. The base code does not change between versions; each version loads the prior as substrate. Never fill a held-open variable with assumption.

## Canonical versions

- [v5.1 — The Complete System](versions/v5.1/GFunnel-Methodology-v5.1.md): Full architecture; self-contained; start here.
- [v5.2 — The Framework Run Against Itself](versions/v5.2/GFunnel-Methodology-v5.2.md): Deep-lens runs; narrows held-open variables; no new architecture.
- [v5.3 — The Meta-Tier](versions/v5.3/GFunnel-Methodology-v5.3.md): First architectural addition; Layer ⊙, the Container.
- [v5.4 — Run 8](versions/v5.4/GFunnel-Methodology-v5.4.md): The first run executed with the meta-tier. Line-Field, Knot-Line, Lamina; motion as tying/untying; three test devices. Derivations only; zero novel predictions claimed.
- [LATEST pointer](versions/LATEST.md): What the current complete framework is.
